title: FDIC BankFind Suite API
questions: largest banks in a state by total assets
quarterly assets and net income of one bank

manual.how: Open the CSV links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (format=csv) in a browser, or use BankFind Suite (https://banks.data.fdic.gov/bankfind-suite/) > the matching tab > filter > Download, and upload the files.

cache.why: Call Report data are updated quarterly and the institution file daily; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: FDIC BankFind data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); FDIC asks users not to imply endorsement.

citation: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, BankFind Suite API ({dataset}), api.fdic.gov/banks, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Count failures only, or failures plus open-bank assistance transactions? The failures table holds both (RESTYPE).
Quarterly income as reported (year-to-date) or converted to quarterly flows? Call Report income fields are year-to-date.
